The Clearcoat slider controls only the B channel of the spec map. Metalness (R) and roughness (G) are separate sliders/channels, so changing clearcoat does not change them. This question made no changes.

Supported built-in finish changes can run locally without an AI provider key or paid model call. A connected external AI may have its own provider charges, but it is not required for supported offline edits. This question made no changes.

To keep an authored Solid color and change only its finish, keep the zone in Solid color mode and leave its current color value unchanged; change only the finish control. Do not switch the zone to Source Paint, which uses the loaded image instead of the authored color. This question made no changes.

Undo checks whether the mask still matches the state recorded with the AI edit. If you drew or changed the mask afterward, that conflicting manual mask is kept and only safe AI-owned values are restored; if the change cannot be separated safely, Undo refuses it. This is not a whole-PSD restore. This question made no changes.
